predecessors.name: Mayapan
predecessors.text: Tihosuco, the capital; 'bordered with Cupul in the north, with Sotuta, Tutul Xiu and Chakán Putún in the west' and 'great forests with little population up to the Bay of Ascension'

successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: Tihosuco, the capital; 'bordered with Cupul in the north, with Sotuta, Tutul Xiu and Chakán Putún in the west' and 'great forests with little population up to the Bay of Ascension'

ledger.x: 1441: 'After the destruction of Mayapán (1441-1461), great rivalry between the Mayas started'; the page gives no date for Cochuah itself (bridge).

1546: 'In late 1546 an alliance of eastern provinces launched an unsuccessful uprising against the Spanish' and the north was conquered; no page gives Cochuah's own end (it joined the 1542 assault on Mérida).

wars.name: Allied assault on Mérida
wars.outcome: The Kuchkabal page has Cupul, Cochuah and Sotuta in 'their allied assault on Spanish forces at Mérida in 1542'; the outcome is not stated.
